As a Data Scientist at [Company name masked], you will help expand our business intelligence capabilities. You will work closely and regularly with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to improve predictive models and support the delivery of data products.
A large part of the role involves staying in contact with both internal teams and external customers — turning user feedback into clear, actionable insights and communicating findings in ways that are easy to understand. You will simplify complex data problems, iterate on solutions, and keep stakeholders informed throughout the process.
As our Data Scientist, you will be responsible for the following:
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Predictive Model Development/Improvement: Lead the development and refinement of predictive models to forecast Estimated Times of Arrival (ETA) for freight, using advanced machine learning techniques. Regularly connect with the team to align on model performance and priorities.
Ad-hoc Data Analyses: Conduct ad-hoc data analyses to uncover insights, support decision-making, and address business challenges. Actively contribute findings in team discussions and walk stakeholders through your conclusions.
Data Infrastructure Development: Take the lead in expanding our data infrastructure, including building out data marts with dbt and integrating new data sources. Initiate conversations with relevant teams to clarify requirements and keep work aligned.
Data Visualization: Create clear, intuitive data visualizations to communicate findings and give stakeholders the information they need to act. Be ready to explain trade-offs and handle questions about the data.
Optimization Problems: Apply optimization techniques and algorithms to solve challenges, particularly with telematics data, to improve operational outcomes. Share progress and surface issues early with the broader team.
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience as a Data Scientist, preferably within the freight or logistics industry.
Solid knowledge of machine learning, statistical modeling, and algorithm development.
Skilled in programming languages such as Python, R, and familiar with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience with optimization techniques and their practical applications.
Proficiency in SQL for data querying and analysis.
Competence in using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or D3.js.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms like AWS, GCP.
Ability to manage multiple projects with diverse objectives simultaneously.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including the ability to present complex data clearly to different audiences.
Comfortable working in a team-oriented environment and engaging regularly with colleagues and customers.
Knowledge of the freight or transportation industry is a significant plus.
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
